preDecided.browserSubstrate: agent-browser@>=0.26.0 (no direct Playwright; agent-browser chat forbidden)
preDecided.decisionProvider: Anthropic SDK direct; haiku-4-5-20251001 for runtime, sonnet-4-6 for finding/interview/fix-prompt
preDecided.webFramework: Next.js 15 App Router (apps/web on 3000, examples/ecommerce-checkout on 3100)
preDecided.narrativesRaw: first-class extras (military_status, bachelors_field, …) flow into PersonaRecord.narratives.raw

immutables.personaProvenance: Persona records must always preserve source provenance; prompt-only personas are forbidden.
immutables.noRealActions: No real purchases, destructive actions, or production data changes.
immutables.secretsMasking: Secrets, passwords, credit cards, tokens, cookies, PII must be masked in all artifacts.
immutables.domainAllowlist: Every run must define and enforce an allowed-domain list.
immutables.paymentBlock: blockPaymentSubmission default true; final purchase confirmation always blocked.
immutables.noUserResearchClaim: Synthetic personas must never be presented as a substitute for real user research.
immutables.automatedVerificationLocale: Korea only — other locales are code-path supported but not test-exercised.

phases.name: Bootstrap
tests: pnpm install succeeds on clean clone
pnpm build / typecheck / lint / test exit 0 on placeholder packages

phases.name: Analyzer
tests: each friction heuristic detects target pattern

demoGates.G1: personabench run --config examples/run-config.checkout.json → ≥3 FrictionSignal + ≥1 high/critical UXFinding
demoGates.G2: Apply fix-prompts/F-001.md to examples/ecommerce-checkout → rerun → personabench compare A B → finding resolved
demoGates.G3: pnpm personabench demo: example boot → run → report.html opens, ≤2 minutes start to finish
demoGates.G4: Clone-and-install distribution; CLI binary global, MCP entry registered, plugin symlinked, all reversible

forbiddenWhileActive: refactor / rename / reorganize unrelated to demo path
new packages/tooling (turbo, nx, changesets, husky, jest, eslint, prettier, mocha)
hosted-track features (auth, multi-tenant, pgvector, separate API server, billing)
different LLM model than haiku-4-5 / sonnet-4-6
code without tests (exception: docs and intentionally-flawed example UI)
